title: Redemption Channels and Telephone Charge by Instrument — Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers
content:
**Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers** are redeemed on the Crestline website or app where the instrument permits online redemption, or through the reservations call center. Each instrument carries its own telephone redemption fee: the ticketing service charge per ticket when the credit is redeemed through the reservations call center, in US dollars.

| Instrument | Can be redeemed on the website or app | Telephone redemption fee (USD per ticket) |
|---|---|---|
| Crestline Residual Travel Credit | Yes | 25 |
| Crestline Flight Credit | Yes | 25 |
| Crestline Trip Credit | Yes | 25 |
| Crestline Service Recovery eCertificate | Yes | 0 |
| Crestline Disruption Voucher | Yes | 0 |
| Crestline Denied Boarding Voucher | No | 0 |

## Desk reading of the table

- Three instruments carry a telephone redemption fee of 25 US dollars per ticket: the Crestline Residual Travel Credit, the Crestline Flight Credit and the Crestline Trip Credit.
- The Crestline Service Recovery eCertificate, the Crestline Disruption Voucher and the Crestline Denied Boarding Voucher carry a telephone redemption fee of 0.
- The Crestline Denied Boarding Voucher is the one instrument that cannot be redeemed on the website or app.

## Terms

- *Can be redeemed on the website or app* states whether the credit can be redeemed online.
- *Telephone redemption fee* is the instrument's figure for the ticketing service charge when the credit is redeemed through the reservations call center, stated per ticket.
